mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Other Super from Hercule's mentor training. The user places a wrapped present that randomly produces one of two documented outcomes: a healing effect or an explosive attack. Current repository evidence notes that the box opens when hit/touched and that the visual pattern can distinguish the result; no exact healing/damage value or outcome probability is promoted.
boundaries: Exact frame data, hidden interactions, patch-independent scaling, and unresolved probabilities remain bounded unless directly established by the cited evidence.
